material_findings: The validator CLI corpus mode evaluates _tokenizer_for_validation(args.model) before validate_corpus validates the independent review receipt, permitting tokenizer/model-snapshot loading before review acceptance.

materialize_model_snapshot accepts an existing byte-identical snapshot without verifying or restoring read-only file and directory modes; model_manifest_at binds bytes but not permissions, so a writable preexisting snapshot can pass custody checks and remain pathname-mutable during loading.
disposition: V25 sealed without an acceptance receipt, acquisition, model effects, or published result. A fresh V26 identity is required for correction.
